blocks.text: Here’s a way to solve an equation that has one variable or unknown value.
Find the value of the variable by using the inverse operation of the
Use inverse operation, subtraction, and subtract 5 from each side of the equation.
Use inverse operation, division, and divide both sides of the equation by 6.
Always do the same operation on both sides of the equation!
